SWE_scaled.Description: Sight word efficiency subtest from Test of Word Reading Efficiency based on adult age range 17 - 24 years (+11 months), but applied to adults older than 25 too

PDE_scaled.Description: Phonemic decoding efficiency subtest from Test of Word Reading Efficiency based on adult age range 17 - 24 years (+11 months), but applied to adults older than 25 too

TWRE_scaled.Description: Scaled total word reading efficiency index

passagecomp_scaled.Description: Passage comprehension scaled subtest of Woodcock Johnson III

RAN_letters (stimuli/sec).Description: Custom rapid automatized naming test for letters calculated as total stimuli named correctly divided by time in seconds

RAN_colours (stimuli/sec).Description: Custom rapid automatized naming test for colours calculated as total stimuli named correctly divided by time in seconds

BlockDesign_tscore.Description: Block design standardized score from Wechsler Abbreviated Intelligence Scale II

MatrixReasoning_tscore.Description: Matrix reasoning standardized score from Wechsler Abbreviated Intelligence Scale II

PRI.Description: Perceptual reasoning index from Wechsler Abbreviated Intelligence Scale II
